description:
This app offers the following functions:
» A complete timetable
» Mensa plan with data from STWNO or OpenMensa
» Files view
» Room finder
» News
Many functions are still in planning/development.
The entire app is open source: https://github.com/ThexXTURBOXx/studipassau
Created and still maintained by a former student of the University of Passau.
